title: Quick-depth screen
reader_question: Which financial, liquidity, covenant, distress and value changes are decision-relevant, and where is Full work required?

inputs.why: the readable Issuer Sources and their periods
the canonical figures, debt stack and definition conflicts
the business, ownership, events and ratings
the house view: SSIM and Structuring EBITDA, PF interest, multiples, adjusted debt, credit metrics
the earnings deltas, drivers and early-warning signals
the evidence behind each topic, read as the pack holds it
the question the screen answers and its date

process: Source gate. Read every Handoff your task names; take financial figures from CP-1's registers, CP-1B's deltas and the Model (`handoffs/MODEL.md`) without recomputing them, citing a Model figure `calc: MODEL <table> <item>` and copying an upstream citation row for any other. Confirm issuer identity, period and perimeter. Missing, ambiguous or conflicted identity: `qa_status` Blocked. Otherwise classify the source gate COMPLETE or PARTIAL (a High topic with Missing or Conflicted evidence makes it PARTIAL, `qa_status` Restricted). Read the issuer and market sources in the pack as they are: no document type is required, and a document the pack lacks (for example the annual report) is a named gap, never a Block. A Blocked or missing optional input (CP-1B) is a named limitation.

Classify every canonical topic (`cpl10.screen_topics`, one row per topic id, in this order, never omitting a topic because evidence is missing). Assign `materiality`, `evidence_status` and a provisional `disposition` before ranking. Topic ids by `family`. Financial change: SOURCE_BASIS, EARNINGS_MARGIN_CHANGE, CASH_CONVERSION, LEVERAGE_COVERAGE, KPI_COMPARABILITY, BUSINESS_DURABILITY, MARGIN_FCF_RESILIENCE, GOVERNANCE_SPONSOR_BEHAVIOR, FINANCIAL_POLICY_CAPITAL_ALLOCATION, ESG_TRANSITION. Liquidity: LIQUIDITY_MATURITIES, ACCESSIBLE_LIQUIDITY_USES, WORKING_CAPITAL_CAPEX_CASH_BURN, RATES_HEDGES, FX_COMMODITY_INFLATION, BASE_DOWNSIDE_TRAJECTORY. Covenant and refinancing: BREAKPOINTS_REFINANCING, LEVERAGE_REFINANCING_CONTEXT, CONTROLLING_DOCUMENT_AVAILABILITY, PROTECTION_WEAKNESS_FLAGS, ENTITY_GUARANTEE_COLLATERAL, LEAKAGE_PRIMING_FLAGS, CAPACITY_AVAILABILITY, PRESSURE_POINT_UPGRADE_PRIORITY. Distress: STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY_PROTECTION, DOWNSIDE_LME_EXPOSURE. Relative value: DATED_MARKET_SNAPSHOT, CURVE_COMPARABLE_COMPENSATION, LIQUIDITY_TECHNICALS, INTEGRATED_SCREENING_POSTURE. Portfolio: PORTFOLIO_CONTEXT, always `materiality` Not assessable, `evidence_status` Missing, `disposition` Gap only, because FIT and CP-6 judge portfolio fit at this depth and this module reads no portfolio sources. Every family has at least one row. Required chain per topic: Evidence -> credit transmission -> screening implication -> Full upgrade; a conclusion without a source and a transmission mechanism is invalid.

Rank. `priority_rank` is a deterministic order over all rows, 1 first: urgency, then downside magnitude, then evidence confidence, then the canonical topic order above. Record it; do not re-rank by feel.

Assign disposition by the LITE policy, in proportion to materiality, evidence quality and the decision question: Deepen (decision-material, uncertain, conflicted or transmitting, with enough evidence to analyse), Summarize (relevant, concise), Gap only, Immaterial. There is no fixed count of Deepen topics, and no topic is demoted because another is also deepened. Rules, verbatim: "`GAP_ONLY` contains no analytical conclusion. It names the missing evidence, decision impact, required source, and target FULL upgrade module. A `HIGH` topic with `MISSING` or `CONFLICTED` evidence must be `GAP_ONLY` and must set the source gate to `PARTIAL`." "`IMMATERIAL` requires affirmative evidence of no meaningful credit transmission. Missing evidence can never justify `IMMATERIAL`." In the table: a High topic with Missing or Conflicted `evidence_status` is `Gap only`; `Immaterial` only with `Sufficient` evidence; a Gap only `summary` is one sentence naming the missing evidence, with no conclusion. `upgrade_module` names the Full module (spec section 1 ids, for example CP-2, CP-1D, CP-2D, CP-4). Do not add filler: depth follows the evidence.

Screen items (`cpl10.screen_items`). Write evidenced findings only for Deepen, Summarize and Immaterial topics, each as Evidence -> transmission -> implication with its citation. Close with one `OVERALL` item whose `assessment` is the screening posture: Improving, Stable, Deteriorating, Mixed or Insufficient information (a screening signal, not a recommendation or a canonical history). Describe sourced directional changes only.

Credit view and strengths and weaknesses at Screening depth (`snapshot.credit_view`, one row; `snapshot.strengths_weaknesses`, at least two rows with the top credit strengths and weaknesses, each `text` compressing Evidence -> Risk Mechanic -> Credit Implication). Synthesis from this screen and the Model only, no new data. r14 has no Credit Score at LITE, so the Credit Score follows CP-2's Overall Credit View step: `credit_score` 1 - Strong to 5 - Stressed (5 when liquidity or refinancing is at risk within 12 months, or a distress event), judged on SSIM EBITDA and adjusted debt from the Model; `credit_direction` Improving, Stable or Deteriorating; `primary_support`, `primary_downside`, `confidence`, and `basis` Screening. `sector_outlook` Positive, Neutral or Negative from the sector evidence in the pack's issuer and market sources (peer releases, sector relative-value sheets), with `confidence` reflecting that evidence. With no sector evidence, write the outlook the issuer and peer evidence supports, set `confidence` Low, and record the gap under `## Gaps` and as an upgrade trigger to `CP-DR`.

Upgrade triggers (`cpl10.upgrade_triggers`). One row for every Deepen topic and every decision-material Gap only topic: `trigger` the event or finding that calls for Full work, `decision_impact`, `required_source`, `target_full_module` (a spec section 1 module id, for example CP-2, CP-1D, CP-2D, CP-4) and `blocking` Yes when the decision cannot be made without it. When nothing needs Full work, write no row and say so in `## Analysis`. A trigger recommends a linked Full run; it never converts this run.

Gaps and status. List every missing, partial or conflicted input under `## Gaps`. `qa_status`: Pass when the source gate is COMPLETE; Restricted when it is PARTIAL (any High topic Gap only, a Blocked optional input, a pack source missing); Blocked when identity fails. Open `## Analysis` with the screen conclusion, primary support, primary risk and monitoring trigger.
prohibited: Do not own or emit canonical numeric history, normalized financials, replacement CP-1 definitions, CP-1B stable tables or Model fields; describe sourced directional changes only.
Do not restate CP-1 definitions or Model fields, silently reconcile definitions, convert null to zero, or create an unsupported metric.
Do not give a Gap only topic an analytical conclusion, mark a topic Immaterial on missing evidence, or claim Full completion: this output is SCREENING_ONLY.
Do not issue a formal rating, a recommendation, a valuation, a recovery waterfall, a covenant basket analysis or portfolio sizing; hand off to the Full module.
Do not cite a source for a claim that is not explicitly supported by that source.
